facts.fact: Addis Fortune reports that INSA introduced a public key infrastructure data centre with INSA as Root certificate authority issuing digital certificates to national institutions and private companies, launched by Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed on 31 August 2024.

ETH.note: Document states no incident response, strategy adoption, critical infrastructure designation or published figures.
The PKI data centre issues certificates; the document does not say it rents space, power or computing to others.
Only a general sovereignty remark; no state data rule, hosting or contract terms stated.
No government online service or portal stated.
No data centre for hire or state data hosting stated.
